notes.title: Software Update v1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Added

Graphics API (GAPI) abstraction layer and NULL Render Path.
Upgraded to BupSystem Core v0.9.6.1.
Upgraded to JoyFish v0.8.6.1.
Upgraded to FishClip v0.7.1.0.
Cleanup

Input assignment procedures can now be aborted by pressing Esc.
Users now prompted to configure their input assignments on first launch of the program.

notes.title: Software Update v1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
Cleanup

Corrected an issue where Dum Buns couldn’t properly eject themselves from the stage geometry when nudged into it. This was caused by an improper sizing of OID_DUMBUN’s solidity dimensions.

notes.title: Software Update v1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Added

Advanced Options section in HTML Help.
History section in HTML Help.
Cleanup

Corrected an issue where overfeeding a Box Bup could unintentionally reset the software. This was caused by an invalid entry in OID_BOXBUP’s mode table for the BOXBUP_MB_STOP state.
